ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, if $CB=4\,\text{cm}$, $DB=7\,\text{cm}$, and $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$, find the length of $AB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $CB = 4$cm, $DB = 7$cm,\\
thus $DC = DB - CB = 3$cm.\\
Also, since $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
thus $AD = DC = 3$cm,\\
therefore $AB = AD + DB = \boxed{10cm}$.
